texts.en:
Using recently-developed technology, an already-extant £mining_station£ Mining Station can now mine a Strategic Resource. These rare resources confer powerful bonuses and make for valuable trade goods. Two metaphorical avians, allegorically struck down by an imaginary projectile.

More information can be found in the Situation Log for a time. There are many more £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources left to discover in the galaxy, so keep on researching!
